attributes.name: The Suture
attributes.powers:
When you encounter The Suture, attempt a Combat 27 or a Charisma or Diplomacy 16 check; if you attempt a combat check, you are dealt 1d6+1 Electricity damage. If you succeed at the check, add this card to your hand; otherwise, shuffle this card back into the location deck it came from.

The Suture cannot be recharged, discarded, buried, or banished.

Reveal this card to reduce damage dealt to you before you act by 3.
